div.div:
Legend
▭ External entity: people or systems outside your control
◯ Process: code you run (P1, P2)
⛁ Data store: where data rests (D1)
→ Data flow: labeled with WHAT data moves (DF-01 to DF-08)
┄ Trust boundary: dashed box; data crossing it needs checking
Reading tips
• Every arrow crossing a dashed line is a STRIDE hot spot.
• P1 runs in the untrusted browser, so P2 must re-check everything P1 sends.
• The Email service sits outside every trust zone: it is a third party.
• Two arrows (DF-02/DF-03, DF-04/DF-05) where data goes both ways with different content.
